subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a supported default-off completed-draft preservation mode, including checklist-style state, instead of only the current compact collapse summary?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the progress window to a compact summary, and the requested behavior adds a new public config and lifecycle policy rather than repairing broken documented behavior.

options.title: Specify a preserve-draft finalization mode
options.body: Define the supported config shape, keep the existing compact summary as the default, and require focused tests plus live Telegram proof for full draft/checklist retention.

options.title: Keep compact summary only
options.body: Decline full completed-draft preservation for now and keep the current one-line activity digest as the only post-final progress artifact.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Leave this issue open as part of a broader cross-channel structured progress-card design rather than adding a Telegram-only boolean.

recommendation.title: Specify a preserve-draft finalization mode
recommendation.body: Define the supported config shape, keep the existing compact summary as the default, and require focused tests plus live Telegram proof for full draft/checklist retention.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Lindsey has the most direct recent commit history on the Telegram collapse/finalization lifecycle this decision would change.
